issue.body:
Hi folks,

I'm just interested if there is an official channel to discuss enhancements and new features for starlette other than github issues?

Is there an already established Slack/Discord/Gitter channel for such purposes?

If not then I think it would totally make sense to share PoCs and premature ideas in one of those rather than polluting the threads in here?

What do you think?
issue.title: Channel to discuss contribution/feature ideas?
